# Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (wrong answer or error)
- [ ] New port of a SymPy function or module
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Release preparation

## SymPy Parity

Name the SymPy source the change follows and how the expected values in the
tests were obtained. If behavior intentionally differs from SymPy, say why.

## Verification

List the checks you ran.

```text
# commands and results
```

## Documentation

- [ ] README updated if needed
- [ ] Help pages or roxygen updated if needed
- [ ] NEWS.md updated for user-facing changes

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, with expected values from SymPy
- [ ] No base R function is masked
- [ ] No local build artifacts, `.Rcheck` output, tarballs, or caches are committed
- [ ] The pull request follows the Code of Conduct
